subject: Post-call: budget guardrails + unit-rate proposal for pilot
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@veloxmed.com>, Nate Brooks <nate.brooks@veloxmed.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-10T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + quick asks (pilot sizing & budget guardrails)

Hi Elena / Nate —

Great to meet today — thanks for walking through VeloxMed's priority use cases and traffic shape. Quick recap and three asks so we can get you a targeted invoice estimate that maps to your procurement window: 

Recap (TL;DR)
- Primary workload: clinical notes classification + triage routing (low latency, bursty spikes during EHR sync windows).
- Expected pilot scope: 3 clinical sites, ~150M tokens/month during steady-state (spike to ~250M/month in go-live weeks).
- Quality target: parity with current rule-based routing for triage F1 > 0.88.

Three asks so we can model a unit-rate and invoice: 
1) Confirm target committed monthly spend range for pilot (you mentioned a ballpark earlier — can you confirm if $800k–$1.4M ARR is the right band?)
2) Confirm whether the pilot requires VPC/private deployment or if hosted (Redwood API) is acceptable for the first 3 months (this materially affects unit pricing).
3) Any procurement constraints (PO lead times, required invoice format or SOW language) we should bake into the estimate?

What I’m preparing for you by EOD Friday: 
- A short, line-item estimate (attached spreadsheet) showing per-1M token unit rates across two model families we discussed, modeled at 150M / month and at a 250M spike profile.
- A one-page pilot scope MOD (PDF) with acceptance criteria and expected trial length.

Notes on unit economics (high level we discussed on call) — these will be expanded in the spreadsheet: 
- Hosted API baseline: we can present a per-1M token rate plus a predictable monthly reservation discount if you commit to a minimum monthly token band.
- Estimated cache/prefix savings: for triage/classification we typically expect 15–30% effective token reduction with prefix caching on repeated templates.
- Qualitative tradeoffs: private deployment adds fixed infra/ops fees but lowers per-token compute costs for large sustained volumes.

Next steps / ask from you by Thu: confirm items 1–3 above so the numbered scenarios match procurement expectations.

Thanks — I’ll route the estimate to this thread once it’s finalized.

Best,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[karthik.iyer@redwood.ai]

--

From: Elena Park <elena@veloxmed.com>

Date: 2027-06-11T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + quick asks (pilot sizing & budget guardrails)

Thanks Karthik — quick answers below: 

1) Budget band: for the pilot we have internal approval to allocate $300k–$420k for the 3-month pilot (not ARR — apologies for the earlier shorthand). If the pilot proves out, procurement anticipates expanding to a $1.2M–$1.5M annualized run-rate for the first year.
2) Hosted API is preferred for the pilot (we want fast time-to-value and fewer infra hoops); we can evaluate Private after the pilot if unit economics justify it.
3) Procurement: standard PO + Net30. SOW should include: data handling language, SOC2 attestation, and an explicit acceptance criteria section with the F1 target.

Two clarifications on volume: the 150M tokens/month estimate is our current best guess for classification inference; during initial ingestion weeks it could spike to ~220–250M/month. On the call we also talked about a smaller embedding job (5–10M tokens/month) for similarity lookups — please model that as a separate line item.

Could you include a worked example that shows: 
- total monthly cost at 150M tokens (classification + embedding)
- total monthly cost at 250M tokens (spike)
- an annualized run-rate at the projected post-pilot level ($1.2M ARR) with what that implies for effective $/1M tokens

If you can get something over by Friday we’ll use it in our internal finance sync next week.

—Elena
Elena Park
Head of Product, VeloxMed
elena@veloxmed.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-06-15T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Post-call recap + quick asks (pilot sizing & budget guardrails) -- estimate attached

Elena / Nate —

Attached two artifacts per your ask: 1) veloxmed_token_estimate_v1.xlsx — worked scenarios; 2) pilot_scope_MOD_20270615.pdf — one page SOW + acceptance criteria. Quick summary of the numbers (see spreadsheet for line-by-line):

Scenario A — Pilot (hosted API) steady-state (150M classification + 7.5M embeddings/month)
- Model mix: family-1 (cost-optimized decoder) for classification: 60% of tokens; family-2 (higher quality) for critical routing bursts: 40%
- Assumed cache/prefix reduction: conservative 15% on classification tokens
- Redwood listed unit rates used in calc (hosted): 
  - family-1 baseline: $1,150 per 1M tokens
  - family-2 baseline: $1,900 per 1M tokens
- Effective blended $/1M tokens after caching & weighting: $1,290 per 1M tokens
- Monthly cost (150M + 7.5M emb): approx $200,000 — $225,000 (range reflects model mix sensitivity)

Scenario B — Spike profile (250M classification + 10M embeddings/month)
- With same assumptions, blended $/1M stays roughly $1,220–$1,260 due to higher reservation efficiency
- Monthly cost: approx $305,000 – $325,000

Annualized run-rate example at post-pilot target ($1.2M ARR)
- $1.2M/year implies an effective ~$1,000 per 1M tokens (if annual volume distribution aligns with pilot scaled across sites).
- To hit that effective rate we recommend a 12-month committed reservation that guarantees minimum monthly tokens (we modeled 1.2B tokens/year in the spreadsheet).

Other notes / levers: 
- Committed bands: we show a 10% and 18% discount band for 6- and 12-month reservations respectively (see 'Discount sensitivity' tab).
- Private deployment: one-time infra/ops add (modeled as $45k/mo in the 'Private' tab) but per-1M token compute could drop by ~15–20% at sustained >1B tokens/year.
- Invoice formatting: the attached PDF aligns with your PO needs (line items + acceptance criteria + Net30 payment term).

Attachments (stubs):
- [Attachment: veloxmed_token_estimate_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 34KB)]
- [Attachment: pilot_scope_MOD_20270615.pdf (application/pdf, 12KB)]

Requested next steps: 
1) Elena: confirm receipt and whether the numbers match what you need for Friday's finance sync.
2) Nate: can you share any internal billing contact or preferred PO numbering convention?
3) Lauren / Ben: can you review the discount bands in the spreadsheet and confirm the recommended inline concession for a 3-month pilot that converts to 12-month reservation?

If helpful I can block 30 minutes Thu for a walk-through of the spreadsheet — available 09:00–11:00 PT.

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
